test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1
solution:
The correct answer is 'to'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In the context of the sentence, "to" is used to show the relationship between the surprise and the group of Scheduled Tribes.
 
• The phrase "a surprise to someone" is a correct grammatical construction.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 3'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• "Off" generally indicates separation or removal and is not suitable in this context.
 
• "In" indicates location or position, which does not fit the phrase "a surprise in Scheduled Tribes."
 
• "At" generally indicates a specific point or location, which is also incorrect in this sentence.
